step: mix with cocoa mass, sugar and cocoa butter, conche
text: Milk powder is mixed with sugar, cocoa mass and cocoa butter in a roll refiner or conche, because water would spoil the flow of the liquid chocolate. Crumb route: cocoa liquor and sweetened condensed milk are dried to a brittle powder (browned by Maillard reactions), then liquefied with more cocoa butter, refined and conched. UK/Ireland/Malta may sell "family milk chocolate" with 20 % cocoa solids and 20 % milk solids.
